Every search Client span for rate.Rate/GetRates (218 in the incident) gains about 1.3 to 2.9 s before rate's Server span starts, while rate's Server time stays near 0.8 ms. The geo contrast is a different connection, not a different route. The gap is bimodal, clustering near 1.4 s and again near 2.8 s, rather than a steady application-layer hold.
